Voronoi Koala

v52026-10-13 · even cells: no opening much bigger than its neighboursAfter the spacing is set, every seed is moved to the centre of the surface it owns, 30 times over, so the cells on the back of the head and the lower back that printed visibly bigger on v4 close up toward their neighbours (largest visible cell 1.6x the median down to 1.3x). Of seven seed rolls, seed 5 needs the least support.
